claim: Evening star (Washington, D.C.), April 11, 1953, from Los Angeles: a court rite makes an American of actress Hedy Lamarr, who has taken the oath along with 40 other aliens.

evidence.quote:
Drama-Laden Rite
Makes American
Os Hedy Lamarr

evidence.quote:

notes: Fact research lamarr-citizen-2026-11-01 (owner: find at least a naturalization year). A dated contemporary Library of Congress page (AP item, Evening star, April 11, 1953) reports that Lamarr has taken the oath in a court ceremony. event_date is the year only: the item says the oath has been taken (the April 10 page, LAM-S-0063, says she gets her citizenship that day), so the publication day is not used as the event day. Same year as LAM-F-0112 (NARA caption of the naturalization card dated April 10, 1953, and The National WWII Museum) and LAM-F-0016.
